name: Mythic+: client data at login
contract: At login the server sends what the client needs for Mythic+ and the Classic Heroics and Mythics without an addon: the Lua string for the Mythic difficulty, the champion count per dungeon, and the affix rows with Tiny swapped out for the week (fixed to 39 with .mythic week, then a relog).

steps.label: A champion count for every timed dungeon (SMSG_PATCH_TIMED_DUNGEON)
Week 39: affix rows with Tiny swapped out (SMSG_PATCH_MYTHIC_AFFIXES)
